paper_id: FaaSLight_ General Application-Level Cold-Start Latency Optimization for Function-as-a-Service in Serverless Computing
title: FaaSLight: General Application-Level Cold-Start Latency Optimization for Function-as-a-Service in Serverless Computing
motivation: FaaS应用的冷启动延迟可达总响应延迟的80%，严重影响用户体验
problem_framing: 将系统级优化问题重新定义为应用级代码加载优化问题
key_insight: 应用代码加载延迟是冷启动主要开销，仅加载必要代码可显著优化
method_signature: 通过函数级调用图识别可选代码并按需加载
evaluation_criteria: 代码加载延迟降低78.95%，总响应延迟降低42.05%
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 静态分析无法100%准确识别可达函数，但保守策略通过按需加载兜底
evidence_for_taste: cold-start latency could be as much as 80%
application code loading latency is a significant overhead
function execution latency only takes less than 5%
developers can hardly control the preparation phase latency
such a design is enough to process serverless functions
thinking_moves: 通过测量研究定位根因，而非假设驱动
将系统级优化问题转换为应用级代码优化问题
平台无关和开发者无关的设计约束
用保守的按需加载策略为激进的静态分析兜底
